summary: Azio AI Holdings, Inc. (formerly Envirotech Vehicles, Inc.) filed an 8-K reporting a name change to Azio AI Holdings, Inc., effective July 9, 2026, via a Certificate of Amendment to its charter. No stockholder vote was required. The common stock ticker will change from EVTV to AZIO, effective July 13, 2026. The board also amended the bylaws to reflect the new name. The filing is a routine corporate name and ticker change; it does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or any event that alters the company's capital structure or control.
